Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to design parts, mechanical assemblies, and capital equipment to meet specific needs in SolidWorks. Support project processes by working alongside customers to meet demand. Collaborate on project cost estimations and budgeting. Create and review shop drawings and bill of materials for custom projects. Work with the team to identify and act on opportunities for continuous improvement.
cond_0621.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
3 Plus years of Capital Equipment Design Experience in SolidWorks
Preferred Requirements:
Experience in a custom manufacturing environment
cond_0621.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
